case.summary: An alert was triggered on card C00543-K1 after transaction 3601725 ($112.75) received a legacy real-time risk score of 0.71. In contrast, the bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.0 with an expected historical fraud rate of 0.63%. The in-person purchase under product code W matches 114 of 116 lifetime transactions on the card, and the cardholder has an established history of 9 prior purchases in billing region 485. Furthermore, the card has no ties to fraud rings and belongs to a clean community with no history of confirmed fraud. The alert was determined to be a false alarm and closed as legitimate.
